subject.title: fix(state): make managed-image additive migration portable across SQLite versions

question: Should the migration preserve only rows with a reconstructable `original_media_root` and delete malformed legacy rows so affected upgrades cannot remain wedged?
rationale: The branch changes recovery behavior for persisted user state; repository policy requires explicit compatibility and migration acceptance rather than inferring the data-retention contract from implementation convenience.

options.title: Accept bounded row filtering
options.body: Merge after confirming managed-image records without a derivable root are transient/unshipped state and may be removed to restore startup.

options.title: Require preservation strategy
options.body: Keep the PR open until the migration can retain or explicitly export every legacy row that lacks a derivable media root.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded row filtering
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming managed-image records without a derivable root are transient/unshipped state and may be removed to restore startup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same legacy state-schema repair path provides the strongest available ownership signal.
